title: One hand steadies a jar while the other lifts its lid
summary: By about 2 years, most children hold one thing while the other hand works, such as gripping a container and taking the lid off, the U.S. CDC says.
body: The CDC 2-year cognitive list includes holding something in one hand while using the other, for example holding a container and taking the lid off. Most children means 75 percent or more by that age. The page says its materials are not a substitute for standardized, validated developmental screening tools. Switches, knobs, and buttons on a toy are a neighboring item and are not copied here. The lid is one picture of two hands doing different jobs. The wording is not a command that a child must succeed, and lists elsewhere can differ.
